citation: Son SB, Lee HK, Kim SJ, Yoon KS. Modeling Behavior of Salmonella spp. and Listeria monocytogenes in Raw and Processed Vegetables. Foods 2024;13(18):2972.

notes: Growth kinetics fitted with the modified Gompertz model (n=4 per mean). Surface growth on vegetables, strain cocktails. Rows with no growth (ND) are not represented. Listeria on cabbage excluded (see external_excluded_rows.csv).
